name: trip expenses, part 3: text editor
description: Part 3 of the trip expenses demo: write the expense report in GNOME Text Editor with the totals from part 2, then open its document statistics.
launch: d=$(mktemp -d); XDG_DATA_HOME=$d XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$d/c XDG_CACHE_HOME=$d/k GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory exec gnome-text-editor --standalone

steps.text:
# Lisbon trip expenses

Flights   412.50
Hotel     389.00
Meals      96.40
Taxi       42.10

Total     940.00
Each of 4 235.00

Checked in Calculator, typed by deskpilot.
